answers.rationale: Protein up; CPTAC and TCGA RNA both up. RCC holds 97.6% of transcripts and the purity interval is above 0. Surface call; vital staining level 1 and no enrichment. DepMap has no dependent lines.

Protein down; TCGA RNA confirms the CPTAC RNA decrease. Macrophages exceed RCC in transcript share. Internal localisation. Vital staining level 2. DepMap fails selectivity. Protein down with replication gives loss_biomarker.

Protein up; RNA up in CPTAC and TCGA, and confirmatory protein up. RCC has the largest share (0.327) and the purity interval is above 0. Surface call; lung staining level 1, no enrichment. DepMap has no dependent lines.

Protein down. TCGA RNA is up, opposite to the CPTAC RNA decrease, so not replicated. RCC has the largest share but the purity interval is below 0. No surface record. Vital protein enriched in liver. No dependent lines. No verdict rule applies.
